pages.text: With JEI or EMI, terminals support R/U lookup, ingredient recognition, synchronized search, missing-material hints, and recipe transfer. Immortal Furnaces and simulated reincarnation have dedicated categories. Without a viewer, this handbook still provides the full flow and real recipe pages.

AE2/RS exchange media bind to the persistent ImmortalStorage player identity and show the latest username. A network mounts only one medium per player. Valid 0.0.8-or-earlier session-UUID bindings migrate in place on first interaction, preserving independent disk IDs, contents, and components.

AE2 registers a direct renderer for ImmortalStorage external resources. Without a rendering addon, FE, Mana, Source, and Souls use bundled textures, while chemicals use the same registry-sampled solid colors as the Xianqiao terminal. Missing render handlers no longer crash the terminal.

Base RS 2.0.9 alone also displays ImmortalStorage external resources. Refined Types or RS Mekanism Integration native keys take priority when installed, while fallback keys stay readable/writable across addon install/removal. Capacity addons such as ExtraStorage coexist through RS's standard StorageContainerItem contract.

FE, Botania Mana, Ars Source, Industrial Foregoing Souls, and Mekanism chemicals use independent long-valued resource keys and a real ledger, appearing only when the corresponding system is available. Legacy Immortal Yuan conversion settings remain readable for old files, but non-source external storage no longer performs that conversion; Source Veins keep their own Immortal Yuan charging.

The Energy Crystal FE memory uses the same independent FE namespace. AE2 and RS read and write amounts larger than 32 bits through their official storage interfaces, while the GUI keeps long values from wrapping negative. Without an optional power mod, the crystal still registers, caches, charges items, and outputs to Xianqiao.

Mekanism, Flux Networks, Botania, Ars Nouveau and Industrial Foregoing connect through their official capabilities and activate only when present. Iron's Spells player mana is intentionally outside the shared ImmortalStorage ledger.

Building Gadgets may use Kongqiao/Xianqiao items as copy-paste materials without consuming them during simulation; a real placement commits extraction. Create's Schematicannon can read the Xianqiao Manager as a standard NeoForge block-item inventory. Beyond Dimensions never replaces or migrates ImmortalStorage storage; both backends remain independent.

Vanilla villager trades can draw exact payment items from personal storage, but Immortal Power never silently substitutes for True Power. Every optional integration is isolated behind its loading boundary, so an absent target mod does not prevent startup.
